note: Niche definitions for the Esteban Moreno Media outbound lane. Each niche = a Google Maps search query set (`queries`) plus optional Instagram user-search terms (`ig_terms`, used by scripts/ig-prospect-scraper.mjs; falls back to `queries`) that produces REAL local businesses with a visual-content need. `angle` is an OFFER-SAFE observation about the vertical: no prices, no packages, no turnaround promises, no guarantees, no drone, no claims about the prospect's results. Discovery is live (Apify Google Maps); emails are harvested from the business's real website at runtime. Nothing here stores a contact address.

niches.label: Independent / BHPH car dealers
queries: buy here pay here car dealer
niches.why: Inventory turns weekly and every unit needs photos plus a walkaround. Proven demand: a Miami photo/video shop cold-pitched this exact offer to Fort Lauderdale Auto Sales on 2026-10-06.
niches.angle_en: Dealers photograph new arrivals every week and the editing is usually the part that falls behind.
niches.angle_es: Los concesionarios graban unidades nuevas cada semana y la edición suele ser lo que se queda atrás.

niches.label: Restaurants and bars
niches.why: Existing lane. High posting cadence, phone footage already exists.
niches.angle_en: Kitchens shoot a lot of phone footage and rarely have time to cut it.
niches.angle_es: En la cocina se graba mucho con el teléfono y casi nunca hay tiempo de editarlo.

niches.label: Wedding and event venues
niches.why: Every event produces footage the venue wants as a reel; seasonal volume spikes.
niches.angle_en: Venues end every weekend with footage from the event and no one to cut the recap.
niches.angle_es: Cada fin de semana el salón termina con material del evento y nadie que arme el resumen.

niches.label: Gyms, CrossFit boxes, personal trainers
niches.why: Daily class footage, owner-operated, used to paying for content.
niches.angle_en: Gyms film classes and clients constantly; the bottleneck is turning it into posts.
niches.angle_es: Los gimnasios graban clases y clientes todo el tiempo; el cuello de botella es convertirlo en publicaciones.

niches.label: Med spas, aesthetics and dental
niches.why: High ticket, before/after visual-first category, big ad budgets.
niches.angle_en: Before-and-after footage piles up on a phone and never becomes a finished clip.
niches.angle_es: El material de antes y después se acumula en el teléfono y nunca llega a ser un clip terminado.

niches.label: Real estate brokerages and agents
niches.why: Every listing is a shoot; agents already film walkthroughs on a phone.
niches.angle_en: Agents film walkthroughs on a phone for every listing and the editing stacks up.
niches.angle_es: Los agentes graban recorridos con el teléfono en cada propiedad y la edición se acumula.

niches.label: Yacht charters, boat dealers, marinas
niches.why: South Florida signature vertical, premium budgets, visually rich. Existing demand-wave note in vault.
niches.angle_en: Charter and boat footage is beautiful raw and rarely gets cut into something postable.
niches.angle_es: El material de charters y barcos es bellísimo en bruto y casi nunca se edita para publicar.

niches.label: Roofing, remodeling, pool and landscape contractors
niches.why: Crews film jobsites daily; transformation content converts and nobody edits it.
niches.angle_en: Crews film the jobsite daily and the before/after never gets assembled.
niches.angle_es: Las cuadrillas graban la obra a diario y el antes/después nunca se arma.

niches.label: Auto repair, detailing, window tint and wraps
niches.why: Visual transformation per job, owner-run, adjacent to the dealer lane.
niches.angle_en: Detail and wrap jobs are a finished video already; it just needs cutting.
niches.angle_es: Un detallado o un wrap ya es un video terminado; solo falta editarlo.

niches.label: Salons, barbershops and nail studios
niches.why: Transformation content, high Instagram dependency, Spanish-first owners.
niches.angle_en: Transformations get filmed every day and most of it never leaves the camera roll.
niches.angle_es: Las transformaciones se graban todos los días y casi todo se queda en el carrete.

niches.label: Nightclubs, lounges and event promoters
niches.why: Weekly recap reels are the core marketing asset.
niches.angle_en: Every night produces clips that need to be a recap before the next weekend.
niches.angle_es: Cada noche deja clips que deben ser un resumen antes del próximo fin de semana.

niches.label: Boutique hotels and short-term rental operators
niches.why: Property content refreshes seasonally; multiple units per client.
niches.angle_en: Property footage gets reshot every season and the editing is outsourced anyway.
niches.angle_es: El material de las propiedades se vuelve a grabar cada temporada y la edición igual se terceriza.

niches.label: Law firms and specialty clinics
niches.why: Big ad spend, weak organic video, Spanish-language audience in South Florida.
niches.angle_en: Spanish-language short video is the gap for most firms here, and the footage is simple to capture.
niches.angle_es: El video corto en español es el hueco de la mayoría de estas oficinas, y grabarlo es sencillo.

niches.label: Marketing agencies and photographers (white label)
niches.why: Repeat B2B volume: they sell the shoot and subcontract the edit. Highest lifetime value per account.
niches.angle_en: Agencies and shooters sell the shoot and then need someone to carry the edit load.
niches.angle_es: Las agencias y los fotógrafos venden la grabación y luego necesitan quien cargue con la edición.

niches.label: Influencers, creators and personal brands
niches.why: Instagram-native niche with almost no Google Maps footprint: creators film every day, publish daily, and the edit is the whole job. Reachable by DM, which is why this niche belongs to the Instagram lane rather than the email lane.
niches.angle_en: Creators film every day and the edit is the part that decides whether it gets posted.
niches.angle_es: Los creadores graban todos los días y la edición es lo que decide si se publica o no.

niches.label: Consultorios médicos, quiroprácticos y fisioterapia
niches.why: Hueco real: el sitio ya tiene dental, med spa y cirugía plástica, pero no consultorio médico general. Dueño-operador, paciente local, y el video corto en español casi no existe en esta categoría en el sur de Florida.
niches.angle_en: Patient-explainer video is the gap in most clinics here, and it is simple footage to capture.
niches.angle_es: El video que le explica algo al paciente es el hueco de casi todos estos consultorios, y grabarlo es sencillo.

niches.label: Pre-construction condo developers and sales galleries
niches.why: Owner-approved wave 8. Launches already own renderings, animations and sales-gallery footage, and sell to Spanish- and English-speaking buyers; page: /services/pre-construction-condo-video-marketing-miami.
niches.angle_en: Pre-construction launches usually have approved renderings and gallery footage that never get cut into short Spanish and English versions.
niches.angle_es: Los lanzamientos en preventa suelen tener renders y material del sales gallery aprobados que nunca se convierten en videos cortos en español e inglés.

niches.label: Vacation-rental hosts and short-term-rental managers
niches.why: Owner-approved wave 8. Hosts film units between stays and rarely edit a clear room-by-room tour; page: /services/vacation-rental-video-marketing-fort-lauderdale.
niches.angle_en: Most rental listings have photos but no short tour that walks a guest through the place in order.
niches.angle_es: La mayoría de los anuncios de alquiler tienen fotos, pero no un recorrido corto que lleve al huésped por la propiedad en orden.

niches.label: Latino insurance agencies (ACA / Medicare agents)
niches.why: Owner-approved wave 8. Agents answer the same Spanish questions every day and the fall enrollment season is predictable; page: /services/insurance-agency-video-marketing-miami.
niches.angle_en: Agents answer the same client questions every week, and few agencies have them as short Spanish videos ready before enrollment season.
niches.angle_es: Los agentes responden las mismas preguntas cada semana, y pocas agencias las tienen en videos cortos en español listos antes de la temporada de inscripción.

niches.label: Spanish-speaking mortgage brokers and loan officers
niches.why: Owner-approved wave 8. Loan officers sell on personal trust and already film talking-head clips; compliance text is theirs to supply; page: /services/mortgage-broker-video-marketing-miami.
niches.angle_en: Loan officers who explain the buying process on camera in Spanish are still rare, and most have more phone clips than edited videos.
niches.angle_es: Todavía son pocos los oficiales de préstamos que explican el proceso de compra en español frente a cámara, y la mayoría tiene más clips en el celular que videos editados.
